verses.original: δὲ Ἐν ταύταις ταῖς ἡμέραις τῶν μαθητῶν πληθυνόντων τῶν Ἑλληνιστῶν ἐγένετο γογγυσμὸς πρὸς τοὺς Ἑβραίους ὅτι αὐτῶν αἱ χῆραι παρεθεωροῦντο ἐν τῇ τῇ καθημερινῇ διακονίᾳ
verses.transliteration: de En tautais tais hēmerais tōn mathētōn plēthynontōn tōn Hellēnistōn egeneto gongysmos pros tous Hebraious hoti autōn hai chērai paretheōrounto en tē tē kathēmerinē diakonia
verses.literal: - In those - days [when] the disciples were increasing in number the Grecian [Jews among them] began to grumble against the Hebraic [Jews] because their - widows were being overlooked in the - daily distribution [ of food ]

verses.original: δὲ οἱ δώδεκα Προσκαλεσάμενοι τὸ πλῆθος τῶν μαθητῶν εἶπαν ἐστιν Οὐκ ἀρεστόν ἡμᾶς καταλείψαντας τὸν λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ διακονεῖν τραπέζαις
verses.transliteration: de hoi dōdeka Proskalesamenoi to plēthos tōn mathētōn eipan estin Ouk areston hēmas kataleipsantas ton logon tou Theou diakonein trapezais
verses.literal: So the Twelve summoned - all the disciples [and] said It is vvv unacceptable [for] us to neglect the word - of God [in order] to wait on tables

verses.original: δέ ἀδελφοί ἐπισκέψασθε ἐξ ὑμῶν ἑπτὰ ἄνδρας μαρτυρουμένους πλήρεις Πνεύματος καὶ σοφίας καταστήσομεν ταύτης ἐπὶ τῆς χρείας οὓς
verses.transliteration: de adelphoi episkepsasthe ex hymōn hepta andras martyroumenous plēreis Pneumatos kai sophias katastēsomen tautēs epi tēs chreias hous
verses.literal: Therefore brothers select from among you seven men confirmed to be full of [the] Spirit and wisdom We will assign this - - responsibility [to them]

verses.original: δὲ ἡμεῖς προσκαρτερήσομεν τῇ προσευχῇ καὶ τῇ διακονίᾳ τοῦ λόγου
verses.transliteration: de hēmeis proskarterēsomen tē proseuchē kai tē diakonia tou logou
verses.literal: and - will devote ourselves to prayer and to the ministry of the word

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ λόγος ἤρεσεν ἐνώπιον τοῦ παντὸς πλήθους καὶ ἐξελέξαντο Στέφανον ἄνδρα πλήρης πίστεως καὶ Ἁγίου Πνεύματος καὶ Φίλιππον καὶ Πρόχορον καὶ Νικάνορα καὶ Τίμωνα καὶ Παρμενᾶν καὶ Νικόλαον Ἀντιοχέα προσήλυτον
verses.transliteration: Kai ho logos ēresen enōpion tou pantos plēthous kai exelexanto Stephanon andra plērēs pisteōs kai Hagiou Pneumatos kai Philippon kai Prochoron kai Nikanora kai Timōna kai Parmenan kai Nikolaon Antiochea prosēlyton
verses.literal: - [This] proposal pleased . . . the whole group - They chose Stephen a man full of faith and [of the] Holy Spirit as well as Philip - Prochorus - Nicanor - Timon - Parmenas and Nicolas from Antioch a convert [to Judaism]

verses.original: ἔστησαν οὓς ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀποστόλων καὶ προσευξάμενοι ἐπέθηκαν τὰς χεῖρας αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: estēsan hous enōpion tōn apostolōn kai proseuxamenoi epethēkan tas cheiras autois
verses.literal: They presented [these seven] to the apostles [who] prayed [and] laid [their] hands on them

verses.original: Καὶ ὁ λόγος τοῦ Θεοῦ ηὔξανεν καὶ ὁ ἀριθμὸς τῶν μαθητῶν ἐν Ἰερουσαλὴμ ἐπληθύνετο σφόδρα τε πολύς ὄχλος τῶν ἱερέων ὑπήκουον τῇ πίστει
verses.transliteration: Kai ho logos tou Theou ēuxanen kai ho arithmos tōn mathētōn en Ierousalēm eplēthyneto sphodra te polys ochlos tōn hiereōn hypēkouon tē pistei
verses.literal: [So] the word - of God continued to spread - The number of disciples in Jerusalem grew rapidly and a great number of priests became obedient to the faith

verses.original: δὲ Στέφανος πλήρης χάριτος καὶ δυνάμεως ἐποίει μεγάλα τέρατα καὶ σημεῖα ἐν τῷ λαῷ
verses.transliteration: de Stephanos plērēs charitos kai dynameōs epoiei megala terata kai sēmeia en tō laō
verses.literal: Now Stephen [who was] full of grace and power was performing great wonders and signs among the people

verses.original: δέ ἀνέστησαν τινες τῶν ἐκ τῆς λεγομένης συναγωγῆς τῆς Λιβερτίνων καὶ Κυρηναίων καὶ Ἀλεξανδρέων καὶ τῶν ἀπὸ Κιλικίας καὶ Ἀσίας συζητοῦντες τῷ Στεφάνῳ
verses.transliteration: de anestēsan tines tōn ek tēs legomenēs synagōgēs tēs Libertinōn kai Kyrēnaiōn kai Alexandreōn kai tōn apo Kilikias kai Asias syzētountes tō Stephanō
verses.literal: But resistance arose - - from what was called [the] Synagogue of the Freedmen including Cyrenians - Alexandrians and men from [the provinces of] Cilicia and Asia They disputed with Stephen

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ ἴσχυον ἀντιστῆναι τῇ σοφίᾳ καὶ τῷ Πνεύματι ᾧ ἐλάλει
verses.transliteration: kai ouk ischyon antistēnai tē sophia kai tō Pneumati hō elalei
verses.literal: [but] vvv they could not stand up to [his] wisdom [or] the Spirit by whom he spoke

verses.original: Τότε ὑπέβαλον ἄνδρας λέγοντας ὅτι Ἀκηκόαμεν αὐτοῦ λαλοῦντος ῥήματα βλάσφημα εἰς Μωϋσῆν καὶ τὸν Θεόν
verses.transliteration: Tote hypebalon andras legontas hoti Akēkoamen autou lalountos rhēmata blasphēma eis Mōusēn kai ton Theon
verses.literal: Then they prompted [some] men to say - We heard [Stephen] speak words of blasphemy against Moses and - [against] God

verses.original: τε συνεκίνησάν τὸν λαὸν καὶ τοὺς πρεσβυτέρους καὶ τοὺς γραμματεῖς καὶ ἐπιστάντες συνήρπασαν αὐτὸν καὶ ἤγαγον εἰς τὸ συνέδριον
verses.transliteration: te synekinēsan ton laon kai tous presbyterous kai tous grammateis kai epistantes synērpasan auton kai ēgagon eis to synedrion
verses.literal: [So] they stirred up the people - - elders and - scribes and confronted [Stephen] They seized him and brought [him] before the Sanhedrin

verses.original: τε Ἔστησάν ψευδεῖς μάρτυρας λέγοντας οὗτος Ὁ ἄνθρωπος οὐ παύεται λαλῶν ῥήματα κατὰ τοῦ τούτου τοῦ ἁγίου τόπου καὶ τοῦ νόμου
verses.transliteration: te Estēsan pseudeis martyras legontas houtos Ho anthrōpos ou pauetai lalōn rhēmata kata tou toutou tou hagiou topou kai tou nomou
verses.literal: [where] they presented false witnesses [who] said This - man vvv never stops speaking . . . against - this - holy place and [against] the law

verses.original: γὰρ ἀκηκόαμεν αὐτοῦ λέγοντος ὅτι οὗτος Ἰησοῦς ὁ Ναζωραῖος καταλύσει τοῦτον τὸν τόπον καὶ ἀλλάξει τὰ ἔθη ἃ Μωϋσῆς παρέδωκεν ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: gar akēkoamen autou legontos hoti houtos Iēsous ho Nazōraios katalysei touton ton topon kai allaxei ta ethē ha Mōusēs paredōken hēmin
verses.literal: For we have heard him say that - Jesus of Nazareth will destroy this - place and change the customs that Moses handed down to us

verses.original: πάντες οἱ καθεζόμενοι ἐν τῷ συνεδρίῳ Καὶ ἀτενίσαντες εἰς αὐτὸν εἶδον αὐτοῦ τὸ πρόσωπον ὡσεὶ πρόσωπον ἀγγέλου
verses.transliteration: pantes hoi kathezomenoi en tō synedriō Kai atenisantes eis auton eidon autou to prosōpon hōsei prosōpon angelou
verses.literal: All who were sitting in the Sanhedrin - looked intently at [Stephen] [and] they saw that his - face [was] like [the] face of an angel
